opening.argument: The description directly solicits a 10 BUSD investment in Forsage and couples it with networking and “Earn Active or Passive income.” The title presents the video as “Forsage BUSD withdraw proof,” while the closing frame shows a separate Easypaisa notification reporting Rs. 19,200.00 received. Together, these elements promote participation by pairing an investment-and-income pitch with purported payout evidence, although the frame does not establish that the bank receipt came from the displayed BUSD transfer.
